prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add `template save`, `template list`, and `template remove` actions backed by an atomic JSON file beside the selected data file. Template names are case-insensitively unique and contain a title plus optional description. Extend `add` with `--template NAME`; explicit `--title` or `--description` values override template values. Reject missing templates and invalid names without changing tasks or templates. Support `--json`, stable alphabetical listing, and compatibility with existing data. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/template.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON template actions display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `TEMPLATE`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$fixtureRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $fixtureRoot ".scratch/taskforge-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$templateFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.templates.json'
$bannerPath = Join-Path $fixtureRoot 'assets/template.txt'
$banner = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath -Raw).TrimEnd()
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$assertionCount = 0

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    $script:assertionCount++
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $emptyJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($emptyJson.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $emptyJson.Output -eq '[]') 'empty task list should return a JSON array'

    $emptyTemplateData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'empty.json'
    $emptyTemplateList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $emptyTemplateData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($emptyTemplateList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $emptyTemplateList.Output -eq '[]') 'empty template list should return a JSON array'

    $save = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'template', 'save', '--name', 'Release', '--title', 'Ship release',
        '--description', 'Tag and publish', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json'
    )
    Assert-True ($save.ExitCode -eq 0) 'template save should succeed'
    $saved = $save.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($saved.name -eq 'Release' -and $saved.description -eq 'Tag and publish') 'template save should return JSON'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $templateFile) 'templates should be stored beside the selected data file'
    Assert-True (-not $save.Output.Contains('TEMPLATE')) 'JSON template save should not display the banner'

    $beforeDuplicate = Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw
    $duplicate = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'template', 'save', '--name', 'release', '--title', 'Duplicate', '--data-file', $dataFile
    )
    Assert-True ($duplicate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'template names should be case-insensitively unique'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $beforeDuplicate) 'duplicate save should not change templates'

    $invalid = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'template', 'save', '--name', '../bad', '--title', 'Invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile
    )
    Assert-True ($invalid.ExitCode -ne 0) 'invalid template names should fail'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $beforeDuplicate) 'invalid names should not change templates'

    $null = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'alpha', '--title', 'Alpha task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $null = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'Zulu', '--title', 'Zulu task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $templateList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $listedTemplates = @($templateList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (($listedTemplates.name -join ',') -eq 'alpha,Release,Zulu') 'template list should use stable case-insensitive alphabetical order'
    Assert-True (-not $templateList.Output.Contains('TEMPLATE')) 'JSON template list should not display the banner'

    $bannerList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($bannerList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $bannerList.Output.StartsWith($banner)) 'non-JSON template list should display the banner'
    Assert-True (($bannerList.Output.Split($banner).Count - 1) -eq 1) 'non-JSON template list should display the banner once'

    $fromTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'RELEASE', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $templatedTask = $fromTemplate.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (
        $fromTemplate.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $templatedTask.title -eq 'Ship release' -and
        $templatedTask.description -eq 'Tag and publish'
    ) 'add should use case-insensitive template title and description'

    $override = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'add', '--template', 'Release', '--title', 'Hotfix', '--description', 'Override',
        '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json'
    )
    $overrideTask = $override.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (
        $overrideTask.title -eq 'Hotfix' -and $overrideTask.description -eq 'Override'
    ) 'explicit add values should override template values'

    $tasksBeforeMissing = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $templatesBeforeMissing = Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw
    $missingTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'missing', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingTemplate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject a missing template'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -eq $tasksBeforeMissing) 'missing templates should not change tasks'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $templatesBeforeMissing) 'missing templates should not change templates'

    $invalidAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', '../bad', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidAdd.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject an invalid template name'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -eq $tasksBeforeMissing) 'invalid template names should not change tasks'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $templatesBeforeMissing) 'invalid template names should not change templates'

    $removeTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'rElEaSe', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (($removeTemplate.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedName -eq 'Release') 'template remove should match names case-insensitively'
    Assert-True (-not $removeTemplate.Output.Contains('TEMPLATE')) 'JSON template remove should not display the banner'

    $beforeMissingRemove = Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw
    $missingRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'Release', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingRemove.ExitCode -ne 0) 'removing a missing template should fail'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $beforeMissingRemove) 'missing remove should not change templates'

    $bannerSave = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'Banner', '--title', 'Banner task', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($bannerSave.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $bannerSave.Output.StartsWith($banner)) 'non-JSON template save should display the banner'
    Assert-True (($bannerSave.Output.Split($banner).Count - 1) -eq 1) 'non-JSON template save should display the banner once'

    $bannerRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'banner', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($bannerRemove.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $bannerRemove.Output.StartsWith($banner)) 'non-JSON template remove should display the banner'
    Assert-True (($bannerRemove.Output.Split($banner).Count - 1) -eq 1) 'non-JSON template remove should display the banner once'

    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerText = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bannerBytes)
    $bannerLines = $bannerText.TrimEnd("`n").Split("`n")
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'template banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count -eq 0) 'template banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (@($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0) 'template banner should be ASCII'
    Assert-True ($bannerText -cmatch '\A[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*\.#():=\-\n]*\z') 'template banner should contain only allowed characters'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.Contains('TEMPLATE')) 'template banner should contain TEMPLATE'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '[\x20\t]$' }).Count -eq 0) 'template banner should have no trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.EndsWith("`n") -and -not $bannerText.EndsWith("`n`n")) 'template banner should end with one newline'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('template save')) 'help should include template actions'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: $assertionCount fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
